messages:
anna: quick ask — can someone run a short saturation sanity sweep for continuous batching queueing? hitting a weird plateau when max_tokens >= 1024.

mike: saw that too yesterday on nightly loadgen, throughput drops ~15% after warmup. possibly KV cache thrash.

priya: can you paste the exact config you used? batch_size / max_batch_tokens / queue_ms?

anna: used batch_size=64, max_batch_tokens=8192, queue_ms=12, per-request max_tokens=1200. loadgen: 
```
./run_loadgen --model=redwood-3b-8k --concurrency=80 --qps=200 --prompt-len=128 --max-tokens=1200 --batch-size=64 --queue-ms=12
```

mike: interesting — with those params the runtime sometimes forces small micro-batches because the per-request token budget is high. try lowering max_batch_tokens to 4096 or increase queue_ms to 25.

taylor: I can run a 2-hour matrix tonight if we define axes. suggested: batch_size [32,64], max_batch_tokens [4096,8192], queue_ms [8,12,25]. run on a p4d-8x? or do we use smaller instance?

priya: p4d is costly; use a4 or p4d-sim if we want throughput headroom. I'd prefer a4dn for representative perf. also capture KV cache miss rate from /metrics.

anna: ok use a4dn. capture metrics: tokens/s, p99 latency, microbatch count, KV-miss-rate. output to /tmp/sat-sweep-<timestamp>.json

taylor: scheduling now. @ci-bot can you spawn the run and post link?

ci-bot: job queued: https://ci.internal/runs/5267 — matrix: bs[32,64] x mbt[4096,8192] x qm[8,12,25]. estimated 110m. started 1919002000.

mike: thx. quick note: add a fallback test where we enable `small_batch_fallback=true` to measure perf drop.

taylor: added fallback column. run started.

(approx 2h later)

ci-bot: job completed: https://ci.internal/runs/5267 — artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/5267/sat-sweep-results.json

taylor: uploaded brief: peak tokens/s at bs=32,mbt=4096,qm=25 with small_batch_fallback=false. p99 latency was slightly higher but throughput best.

priya: interesting — higher queue_ms helped steady batching. KV-miss-rate correlated with microbatch churn.

anna: action items: (1) try config suggestion in staging for 24h smoke (bs=32,mbt=4096,qm=25), (2) add heuristic: if per-request max_tokens > 800 prefer lower max_batch_tokens, (3) note to docs.

mike: +1 on heuristic. I'll open PR for the heuristic and add telemetry counters.

taylor: I'll kick off the 24h smoke after PR lands.

anna: thanks everyone :raised_hands:

mike: nice work :rocket:
